limits: Admission currently covers rewards in quests containing their own commerce bindings
Other-quest prerequisite, optional/minimum/started and chapter/task dependency admission remains open
Monetary PAID claims need separate supported read-only settlement inspection
Offline unretained PREPARED discovery, removed teams and arbitrary callbacks need additional work

Rollback or deletion of every evidence copy cannot be detected
Original content provenance and physical clients remain open
